basic_info.description: Beautifully updated home in the most desirable Ingleside district of San Francisco. This cozy 3 bedroom, 2 bath home offers 1,000 sqft of comfortable living space, ideal for first-time home buyers. Stepping into a bright living room with hardwood floors throughout for a cozy ambiance perfect for relaxing. Alongside the open kitchen including modern cabinetry, sleek countertops, big kitchen island, and stainless steel appliances. The primary bedroom featuring a full bath tucked away in the back for your very own private escape. Outside, a large low maintenance backyard perfect for entertaining. Situated just a few blocks away from Ocean Ave, enjoy easy access to a variety of restaurants, grocery stores (including Whole Foods and Safeway), and local favorites like Philz Coffee and Beep's Burgers. City College of San Francisco and easy access to public transportation with Balboa Park Station just minutes away. Don't miss this opportunity to own a move-in ready home in one of SF's most vibrant neighborhoods!
